from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityCDS(BaseModel):
    """Common Data Set enrollment data for one university for the Fall 2021 reporting period."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    total_undergraduates: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment, Section B1")
    transfer_students: int | None = Field(description="Number of degree-seeking transfer students enrolled, Section D2")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, format YYYY-MM")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityCDS]
